name: dotnet-csharp-source-generators

Creates/consumes Roslyn source generators: `IIncrementalGenerator`, syntax providers, semantic analysis, emission, diagnostics, `CSharpGeneratorDriver` testing, NuGet packaging, `[GeneratedRegex]`, `[LoggerMessage]`, and System.Text.Json `[JsonSerializable]`. See [skill:dotnet-roslyn-analyzers], [skill:dotnet-csharp-modern-patterns], and [skill:dotnet-csharp-coding-standards].

Source generators are shipped as analyzers targeting `netstandard2.0`.

<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
<TargetFramework>netstandard2.0</TargetFramework>
<EnforceExtendedAnalyzerRules>true</EnforceExtendedAnalyzerRules>
<IsRoslynComponent>true</IsRoslynComponent>
<LangVersion>latest</LangVersion>
<PackageReference Include="Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Analyzers" Version="3.3.4" PrivateAssets="all" />
<PackageReference Include="Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp" Version="4.12.0" PrivateAssets="all" />

> **Always target `netstandard2.0`.** Generators load into the compiler process, which requires this TFM for compatibility. Use `LangVersion>latest` to write modern C# in the generator itself.

Always use `IIncrementalGenerator` over the legacy `ISourceGenerator`. Incremental generators are cache-aware and only re-run when inputs change, making them significantly faster in IDE scenarios.

public sealed class AutoNotifyGenerator : IIncrementalGenerator
public void Initialize(IncrementalGeneratorInitializationContext context)

Use `ForAttributeWithMetadataName` or `CreateSyntaxProvider` with a tight predicate. Transform to simple data (strings, records). Never pass `ISymbol` or `SyntaxNode` through the pipeline (they hold the compilation alive and break caching). Use value equality via `record struct` or `IEquatable<T>`. Same inputs must produce identical source; use `// <auto-generated/>` and `#nullable enable`.

Use fully qualified names, group by containing type, and emit deterministic `{TypeName}.{Feature}.g.cs` files. Handle global namespaces. This example targets top-level, non-generic classes; production generators should handle generic and nested types. Report a diagnostic for unsupported shapes rather than emitting invalid code. Prefer raw string literals for templates.

Report errors and warnings through `SourceProductionContext` rather than throwing exceptions. To report location-specific diagnostics, include a `Location` in your pipeline data. `Location` is not value-equatable, so including it in your pipeline record breaks incremental caching. A common pattern is to carry it as a separate field that you exclude from equality, or report diagnostics in a `CreateSyntaxProvider` step before projecting to value types.

ctx.AddSource("AutoNotifyAttribute.g.cs", """

public void Initialize(IncrementalGeneratorInitializationContext context)

This example targets top-level, non-generic classes; production generators should handle generic and nested types. Report a diagnostic for unsupported shapes rather than emitting invalid code. Prefer raw string literals for templates.

Report errors and warnings through `SourceProductionContext` rather than throwing exceptions. To report location-specific diagnostics, include a `Location` in your pipeline data. `Location` is not value-equatable, so including it in your pipeline record breaks incremental caching. A common pattern is to carry it as a separate field that you exclude from equality, or report diagnostics in a `CreateSyntaxProvider` step before projecting to value types.

Use `RegisterPostInitializationOutput` for marker attributes and helper types that do not depend on user code:
context.RegisterPostInitializationOutput(static ctx =>
ctx.AddSource("AutoNotifyAttribute.g.cs", """

Use `CSharpGeneratorDriver` to run generators in-memory and verify output.

using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;
using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;
var syntaxTree = CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source);
var references = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies()
.Where(a => !a.IsDynamic && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(a.Location))
.Select(a => MetadataReference.CreateFromFile(a.Location));
var compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create("TestAssembly",
new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));
var generator = new AutoNotifyGenerator();
GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(generator);
driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(
compilation, out var outputCompilation, out var diagnostics);
Assert.Empty(diagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));
var runResult = driver.GetRunResult();
Assert.Single(runResult.GeneratedTrees);

For snapshot testing use [Verify.SourceGenerators](https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.SourceGenerators).

GeneratedRegex: compile-time, zero runtime compilation, AOT-compatible. Method must be `static partial` returning `Regex`; place it on a `partial class` or `partial struct`. Supports all `RegexOptions` except `RegexOptions.Compiled` (which is ignored -- the source generator replaces it).

LoggerMessage: methods must be `static partial` in a `partial class`. Parameters matching `{Placeholder}` are structured data. `Exception` is logged automatically (do not include in message template). Event IDs are auto-assigned; specify explicit IDs for stable telemetry.

System.Text.Json source generation is AOT-compatible and eliminates runtime reflection. Register all types needing serialization in `[JsonSerializable]`. Use `TypeInfoResolverChain` (net8.0+) to combine contexts. Required for Native AOT -- reflection-based serialization is trimmed.

<ProjectReference Include="..\MyGenerator\MyGenerator.csproj"

When shipping a generator as a NuGet package, place the assembly under `analyzers/dotnet/cs/`:

_._
<!-- In the generator .csproj -->
<IncludeBuildOutput>false</IncludeBuildOutput>
<DevelopmentDependency>true</DevelopmentDependency>
<None Include="$(OutputPath)\$(AssemblyName).dll"
PackagePath="analyzers/dotnet/cs" />

// Add to Initialize() for attach-debugger workflow
if (!System.Diagnostics.Debugger.IsAttached)
System.Diagnostics.Debugger.Launch();

<!-- In the consuming project -->
<EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles>true</EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles>
<CompilerGeneratedFilesOutputPath>Generated</CompilerGeneratedFilesOutputPath>

Add `Generated/` to `.gitignore`.
